canonical_name: DataVita DV4 Data Centre and Battery Storage, Lancaster Avenue, Chapelhall
summary: Early-stage DataVita proposal on Green Belt land at Lancaster Avenue, Chapelhall, within the Lanarkshire AI Growth Zone. A PAN was lodged in December 2025 and North Lanarkshire Council decided in June 2026 that EIA was not required for a c.100-124 MW data centre. On 2 September 2026 DataVita announced that it had submitted a planning-permission-in-principle application, with a revised maximum height of 26 m, closed-loop cooling and site-specific economic and community claims. No validated council reference was located by 3 September, so the record remains at M1/pre-application rather than treating a developer-announced submission as a live validated case. The 500 MW headline belongs to the wider zone, not DV4 alone.
maturity_explanation: PAN 25/01322/PAN and EIA screening 26/00707/EIASCR are confirmed official records. DataVita says it submitted a planning-permission-in-principle application on 2 September 2026, but no reference or validation record appeared in the council's weekly list when checked on 3 September. Under this Observatory's method, it remains M1 until validation is confirmed.
anticipated_operational_date: UK Government FoI response (per APRS): 'DV4 will be driven by Scottish Power connections timescales which we expect to be brought forward to 2027'

latest_development.headline: DataVita announced submission of a revised DV4 planning application; council reference and validation still awaiting confirmation
